listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Miami Beach bus tour. On your right, there is Ocean Drive. On your left, there are many hotels and restaurants. The beach is very beautiful at sunset, at about six p.m. And this weekend, there is a free concert on the beach. Have a great weekend!

Hi, Eliane! It is Rosa, from apartment 1206. This weekend there is a party at the pool, on Saturday at five. There is food, music and a beautiful sunset. My husband Tom is the cook! Are you and your husband free? See you on Saturday!

extra_audio.text: Eliane is on the plane to Miami. At immigration, she says: Vacation. At the restaurant, she says: I would like a salad. At the store, she says: Can I try it on? This weekend, there is a party at the pool.

paras: Hi, Ana! This is my first week in Miami with English. On the plane, I am in seat 14A. At immigration, the officer asks: What is the purpose of your visit? I say: Vacation. No problem!

Our apartment is on floor twelve, and the view of the beach is beautiful. Breakfast is at eight. Then, exercise: a walk on the beach. At the restaurant, I say: I'd like a salad, please. At the store: Can I try it on? These shoes are forty dollars, on sale!

Is there a pharmacy near here? Yes, there is: on Ocean Street. This weekend, there is a party at the pool, and the sunset is at six. At night, my husband and I are on the sofa with our series. Is my English perfect? No, it is not. But I am not afraid now. Kisses, Eliane.
